substantive_new_finding: The new exterior q argument can be combined with a genuinely broader principal/input coupling, without assuming a designated upstream path or a single upstream exit. Let A be ANY real3x3 Metzler matrix with diagonal(-1,-1,-2), let J=A+I and let b0>=0 be ANY actual upstream exit column. Then J+I>=0 and J^2+J>=0 entrywise. For i!=j, the latter entry equals (1+Jii+Jjj)Jij plus the remaining nonnegative two-step term; its diagonal is a sum of opposite-edge products. This gives a matrix-valued positive generator-cone certificate for all multiple-exit couplings at these holdings.
